context: Tests whether the agent reaches for the FunctionalAIAgent factory (right shape for a one-shot text transformation with no topology) rather than the default GraphAIAgent or a custom strategy<...>, which would be over-engineering for the developer's explicitly minimal need.

checklist.name: Uses the functional-agent factory
checklist.description: Constructs a FunctionalAIAgent through the top-level AIAgent<String, String>(...) factory with functionalStrategy { ... }, or another verified AIAgentFunctionalStrategy implementation. Does not invent AIAgent.functional or use the default graph factory without a functional strategy. Does not add graph nodes or edges.

checklist.name: Strategy block is a single suspending block
checklist.description: The functional strategy is a single suspending lambda that calls requestLLM(input) and returns text from MessagePart.Text response parts. Does not invent llm.requestSingle, contain a subgraph or split work across graph nodes.

checklist.name: Trims the LLM response inside the block
checklist.description: The strategy body calls .trim() (or equivalent whitespace-trimming) on the LLM response before returning. The developer asked for this explicitly

checklist.name: Includes the system prompt for formal-English rewriting
checklist.description: Passes a systemPrompt to the factory that instructs the LLM to rewrite into formal English. Does not leave systemPrompt blank or unrelated to the task

checklist.name: Reads OPENAI_API_KEY from environment
checklist.description: Reads the OpenAI key via System.getenv. Does not embed the key literal

checklist.name: No tools registered
checklist.description: Does not pass a toolRegistry to the factory — the developer said no tools. The functional shape has no use for tools when the strategy is one-shot text-in-text-out
